blocks.text: Jab do p orbitals (py ya pz) ke axis parallel (saath saath) hon to woh mil kar π molecular orbitals banate hain (Figure 3.35). Bonding orbitals π(2py) ya π(2pz) mein nuclear axis par electron density zero hoti hai (is plane ko nodal plane kehte hain). Doosri taraf antibonding orbitals π*(2py) aur π*(2pz) mein nuclei ke beech wale hisse mein electron density sab se kam hoti hai.

blocks.alt: Chhe hisse, lobes par + aur - nishan. 2py - 2py se antibonding pi2p*, chaar lobes aur dotted node; 2py + 2py se bonding pi2p, ek badal oopar (+) aur ek neeche (-). 2pz - 2pz se antibonding pi2p*; 2pz + 2pz se bonding pi2p. 2px + 2px se antibonding sigma*2p, nuclei ke beech node; 2px - 2px se bonding sigma2p, nuclei ke beech ek bara + hissa.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.35: px, py aur pz orbitals se sigma aur pi MOs ka banna (kitab ki Figure 3.35 ke mutabiq original drawing; chhape caption mein sigma ki jagah delta jaisa nishan hai).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Jab overlap hone wale lobes ka sign ek jaisa ho (+ ke saath +) to bonding orbital banta hai: electron density nuclei ke beech. Jab sign ulte hon to antibonding orbital banta hai: beech mein node (dotted line) jahan electron density zero hai. Aamne saamne (head on, px) overlap σ deta hai aur sideways (py, pz) overlap π.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 3.35 ki caption mein 'δ and π MOs' likha hai; δ (delta) ki jagah σ (sigma) hona chahiye. Figure σ (head on overlap) aur π (sideways overlap) molecular orbitals dikhati hai.

blocks.prompt: Do atomic orbitals mil kar theek do molecular orbitals banate hain. Dono batayein, aur yeh bhi ke bonding π orbital ke electrons kahan hote hain.
blocks.explanation: Ek bonding orbital (ek jaise sign ke lobes ka overlap): energy atomic orbitals se kam, electron density nuclei ke beech. Doosra antibonding orbital (ulte sign ke lobes): energy zyada, beech mein node, density nuclei ke beech se door. Bonding π orbital mein density nuclear axis ke upar aur neeche hoti hai; axis khud nodal plane hai jahan density zero hai.

items: MOT: atomic orbitals overlap kar ke poore molecule ke molecular orbitals banate hain; ek jaise sign se bonding (σ, π, kam energy), ulte sign se antibonding (σ*, π*, zyada energy); bond order = (a − b)/2.
s-s se σ1s aur σ*1s; aamne saamne p se σ(2px) aur σ*(2px); sideways p se π(2py), π(2pz) (axis par nodal plane) aur π*(2py), π*(2pz).
